channel.title: Opal blog
channel.description: Release notes and writing about Opal, a JavaScript toolkit built on one module graph.

item.title: Opal v0.3.1
item.description: The launch release: cleaner terminal output, a new download bar, and opal upgrade. Resolution, downloads, and linking are unchanged, so the benchmarks measured on v0.3.0 still hold: warm and no-op installs timed the same on both builds.

item.title: Opal v0.3.0
item.description: Opal now installs the versions npm would install. On six edge-case fixtures the trees match npm's package for package, and on a 365-package Next.js scaffold 432 of npm's 433 package versions match.

item.title: Opal v0.2.1
item.description: A performance fix for one finding: a 367-package Next.js install spent most of its time parsing package metadata it never used, and almost none of it on the network.

item.title: Opal v0.2.0
item.description: Correctness, speed, and visibility across the package manager. Four bugs in this release produced a wrong node_modules without ever failing an install.

item.title: Opal v0.1.0
item.description: The first release: opal install, with prebuilt binaries for Linux and macOS and an install script.
